$comment: The seams this package cannot carry, and why. npm does not pack a symlink as a symlink: it is dropped or dereferenced, so a path that exists in the git tree can be absent from the published tarball. Every entry here is a path the compliance wards would otherwise report as missing/dead INSIDE the artifact, with the door that seats it on a real machine. Read by bin/packaged-gate.sh and by the compliance wards when they run against an unpacked artifact.

seams.why: Rule 02: the harness skill dirs are symlinks to the canonical tree. A machine seats them at install; the tarball must not carry a copy that could drift from the canonical one.

seams.seated_by: bin/ymir-install.sh (apps step) — the smithy is cloned from zerwiz/smidja
seams.why: The factory is a clone of another repository and is deliberately not tracked here; shipping a copy would defeat the clone.
The judge's asset mirror is one canonical tree seen twice (the sync ward proves they agree). A shipped copy would be a second copy, which is the exact drift the ward exists to prevent.
